extraction.experiment: Raising d_k with the 1/√d_k scaling switched off makes the softmax inputs grow like √d_k, so each query's attention collapses onto one key; with scaling on, the weights stay spread out. This is the motivation the paper gives for scaling in 3.2.1.
extraction.reproduce: With the 1/√d_k scaling on, the softmax inputs keep unit spread even at d_k = 512, and attention stays spread over several keys.
extraction.contrast: Without scaling at the same d_k, the dot products grow to a spread of about √d_k, and the softmax saturates toward one-hot.
